description: Two independent gate delay lines, each giving up to 40 seconds of delay with voltage control over the time

params.text: Sets that section's delay time, between zero and the number of seconds chosen on the range switch
Attenuverts the time CV before it is added to the DELAY knob
Sets the longest delay the DELAY knob reaches, at 2.5 seconds, 5 seconds, 10 seconds, 20 seconds or 40 seconds

inputs.text: Voltage control over that section's delay time, attenuverted and added to the DELAY knob

outputs.text: The incoming gate passed straight through, undelayed
The incoming gate delayed by the set time
Goes high whenever either the undelayed gate or the delayed gate is high

notes: moving a range switch from a shorter setting to a longer one can put a gate out a second time, because gates already in the delay line are read again at the new spacing
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
